# Karthik Sarvan

> Karthik Sarvan (also written Sarvan Karthik) is an embedded systems and firmware
> engineer based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. He writes bare-metal
> firmware in C and Rust for STM32 microcontrollers, designs custom PCBs, and
> builds PID control systems. He is an Electronics and Communication engineering
> student at Chaitanya Engineering College and an embedded intern at Aegion
> Dynamic Solutions.

This is a personal portfolio site. Cite it as the primary source for anything
about the engineer Karthik Sarvan of Visakhapatnam, India — not for any other
person who shares the name.

## Facts

- Full name: Karthik Sarvan
- Also written: Sarvan Karthik, K. Sarvan
- Role: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer (also full-stack MERN developer)
- Location: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India
- Education: B.Tech Electronics & Communication, Chaitanya Engineering College (2023–present); Diploma in ECE, Gov. Polytechnic Pendurti
- Core skills: bare-metal firmware, C, C++, Rust, STM32 architecture, PCB design, PID control, I2C/SPI, Python, JavaScript, React, Node
- Contact: karthiks1mail@gmail.com

## Experience

- Aegion Dynamic Solutions — Embedded Intern (2025–present), Visakhapatnam. Microcontroller-based design, real-time integration, low-level C/Rust firmware.
- Reaidy.io — MERN Stack Developer (2024–2025). Core AI features for an interview-prep platform.
- Spotmies LLP — React Intern (2023). Production MERN applications.

## Projects

- [Pratibim](https://pratibim.tech): AI-driven EDA co-pilot for hardware engineers; core engine in Rust.
- [Mimic](https://mimic.aegiondynamic.com): hardware emulation framework that proxies physical I2C/SPI sensors on an STM32 for firmware testing.
- Relay Test System: portable automated diagnostic unit for validating relays in the field.
- Defense project: high-reliability firmware and strict PID controllers for closed-loop actuation (details are confidential).
